fr.short: Protocole de communication client-serveur pour le transfert de documents web, base du world wide web
fr.full:
**HTTP** est le protocole de communication client-serveur pour le transfert de documents web (HTML, images, APIs), base du World Wide Web.

Fonctionnement : client envoie requête (méthode + URL + headers), serveur répond (code status + headers + body).

Méthodes : GET (récupérer), POST (créer), PUT (modifier), PATCH (modification partielle), DELETE (supprimer). Codes status : 2xx (succès), 3xx (redirection), 4xx (erreur client), 5xx (erreur serveur). Limitation : communication non chiffrée. Solution : HTTPS (HTTP + SSL/TLS).

en.short: A client-server communication protocol for transferring web documents, the foundation of the World Wide Web
en.full:
**HTTP** is the client-server communication protocol for transferring web documents (HTML, images, APIs), the foundation of the World Wide Web.

How it works: the client sends a request (method + URL + headers), and the server returns a response (status code + headers + body).

Methods: GET (retrieve), POST (create), PUT (update), PATCH (partial update), DELETE (remove). Status codes: 2xx (success), 3xx (redirection), 4xx (client error), 5xx (server error). Limitation: communication is unencrypted. Solution: HTTPS (HTTP + SSL/TLS).
